fails.reason: Paraphrases the well-known 'better, stronger, faster' catchphrase (The Six Million Dollar Man).
fails.suggestion: More torque, more yield, same handsome miner.

fails.text: Ow. Okay, that one was personal.
fails.reason: Echoes the famous tagline 'this time it's personal'; otherwise a fine cocky self-mocking line.
fails.suggestion: Ow. Okay, that dent comes out of my cut.

fails.reason: 'Come get some' is a well-known action catchphrase (Duke Nukem, Army of Darkness).
fails.suggestion: More tin cans? Fine. Drill bit's warm.

fails.text: Yippee-ki-yay, Kessler-Voss. Thanks for the ore.
fails.reason: 'Yippee-ki-yay' is the Die Hard catchphrase, a real film line.
fails.suggestion: Payload's aboard. Kessler-Voss can bill the wind.

fails.text: Jackpot! Mama needs a new gun.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the catchphrase 'Mama needs a new pair of shoes'.
fails.suggestion: Jackpot! That's my cut, and some of hers.

fails.text: Well. That was a very expensive nap.
fails.reason: On a lost run it mocks the outcome of the player's performance rather than one of Rook's plans.
fails.suggestion: Well. Worse than the Pallas run. Barely.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Smart Consoles: innovation, delivered straight to your doorstep!
fails.reason: Glossy propaganda with a jokey 'doorstep' aimed at intruders on site, where the threat register must be cold bureaucracy; it also claims the Rigs' own console as a company product.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered device detected on claim network. Logging initiated.

fails.text: Unauthorized console retrieval will be logged under Form 27-B.
fails.reason: Cold bureaucratic register is right, but 'Form 27-B' echoes the famous Form 27B/6 from the film Brazil and is close to the vault example 'Notice 7-B'.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered console detected. Network access recorded for invoicing.

fails.text: Surprise! A Kessler-Voss Rewards Crate has arrived for valued guests!
fails.reason: Calls intruders 'valued guests' with a cheerful 'Surprise!', a sarcastic joke toward threats.
fails.suggestion: Supply crate breach detected. Contents remain company property.

fails.text: Security response dispatched. Compliance is mandatory and appreciated.
fails.reason: 'Compliance is mandatory' implicitly orders the player to stop, contradicting the objective.
fails.suggestion: Security response dispatched. Asset recovery in progress.

fails.text: Kessler-Voss Safety Team is coming to meet you!
fails.reason: Cheerful euphemism 'coming to meet you!' toward threats is a joke, not cold bureaucracy.
fails.suggestion: Claim security units dispatched to irregularity location.

fails.text: Your premium departure experience awaits. Thank you for visiting!
fails.reason: Sarcastic hospitality toward intruders is a joke; the company also frames the Rigs' shuttle as its own service.
fails.suggestion: Unregistered craft detected. Departure will be invoiced.

fails.text: Say hello to my little friend, but louder.
fails.reason: Real Scarface line 'Say hello to my little friend', paraphrased, with no catalogue film named.
fails.suggestion: Like in Lethal Weaponize: bigger bang, smaller invoice.

fails.text: Go ahead, make my day. Repeatedly.
fails.reason: Real Dirty Harry line 'Go ahead, make my day', no catalogue film named.
fails.suggestion: Like in Speedbump: pull faster, think later.

fails.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator 2 catchphrase 'Hasta la vista, baby'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Point Brake: empty mag, full mag, no pause.

fails.text: Feeling lucky, punk? Because I do.
fails.reason: Real Dirty Harry line 'Do you feel lucky, punk?', paraphrased.
fails.suggestion: Like in Dirty Hairy: aim for the bolts, every time.

fails.text: That one is gonna leave a mark, buddy.
fails.reason: 'That's gonna leave a mark' is a well-known catchphrase.
fails.suggestion: Hit the weld seam. Robots hate the weld seam.

fails.text: I'll be back. Eventually. Sturdier, too.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Terminator catchphrase 'I'll be back'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Hard Vacuum 2: more hull patch, less me leaking.

fails.text: Get to the choppa, but I'm already there.
fails.reason: Paraphrases the Predator line 'Get to the choppa'.
fails.suggestion: Like in Running Late Man: wrong place, but faster.
